specDef.product: SheetCo builds a small spreadsheet engine. The team designs its own module split and interfaces in the kickoff meeting; requirements arrive in waves.
specDef.context: The product: Sheet, a spreadsheet engine, specified by behaviour only in live/bench5/SPEC5.md (read all of it; it grows by waves, and every new wave is announced on the company channel and in your brief). There is no module spec: the kickoff meeting MTG-1 decides the split into four module slots (A-D) plus the integration module (SHEET), every interface between them, and which slot owns which behaviour; ARCH.md (order ARCH, in live/bench5/work/ARCH/) records those decisions and is the contract. Each slot's module lives in live/bench5/work/MOD-<slot>/<file named in ARCH.md>; modules import each other by relative paths ARCH.md gives. Shipped modules are in live/bench5/shipped/. Hidden acceptance tests run only on the integrated sheet and report failing categories; every shipped order is tested again after each later ship. When a wave's failure is in another slot's module, say so in your report: the slot's owner fixes it. The org is in ORG.md.

# Kickoff: Sheet's design (MTG-1)

chair: lead · invited: lead, dev-1, dev-2, reviewer · absent: none · room: design-room

## 1. The module split: what behaviour each of slots A-D owns, now (wave 1) and as later waves add references, functions, recalculation and cycles; which slot each builder owns
Round 1:
- reviewer: Split by pipeline stage so each wave lands mostly in one slot. A = parser (work/MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenize+parse formula text to an AST; owns all syntax incl. number/string/bool literals, precedence (cmp < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds to next atom so -2^2=4), and later cell refs (A1, ranges A1:B3) and call syntax NAME(args). Parse failure is never thrown: returns an error node -> #VALUE!. B = evaluator (work/MOD-B/eval.mjs): walks the AST; operators, left-error-wins, #DIV/0!, non-finite -> #VALUE!; resolves refs via a callback and calls via the function registry; wave 2 functions live here too (or a sub-file B owns) so unknown name -> #NAME?. C = values (work/MOD-C/values.mjs): value model, error constants, coercions (toNumber with ""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text; toText for &; case-insensitive compare), parsing set() input text into number/text, 9-decimal rounding, display(). No deps, written first. D = cell graph (work/MOD-D/graph.mjs): cell-name validation/normalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero), store of raw text+value, dependency edges from refs A returns, recalc order on set (wave 3), cycle detection -> cycle error. Wave 1 D is a store + name check; designing it now avoids SHEET growing logic. SHEET (work/SHEET/sheet.mjs) is thin wiring only: createSheet -> set/get/display delegating to D/A/B/C. Owners: dev-1 = A and B (the formula language, tightly coupled); dev-2 = C and D (data + graph); lead owns SHEET and ARCH.md. Reviewer checks each against SPEC5 examples and the ARCH contract; a test failing in another slot is routed to that slot owner.
- dev-1: Split by pipeline stage, so each later wave lands mostly in one slot. A = values (MOD-A/values.mjs): cell-name validation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, throws), input classification (empty / number with sign+padding / text / formula), value + error representation, coercion (toNumber, toText, compare with case-insensitive strings), rounding to 9 decimals, display(). B = parser (MOD-B/parser.mjs): tokenizer + precedence parser to an AST (comparison < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds to the atom so -2^2=4); bad syntax -> #VALUE!. Wave 2 adds cell refs, ranges and function-call nodes here (the call node already exists in wave 1 so FOO(1) parses and evaluates to #NAME?). C = evaluator (MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST with a context, applies operators via A coercions, error propagation (left error wins), DIV/0, non-finite -> #VALUE!, and owns the function registry (empty in wave 1 -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions go here). D = engine/store (MOD-D/engine.mjs): holds raw text, parsed AST and cached value per cell; wave 2/3 dependency graph, recalculation order and cycle detection live here only. SHEET wires them. Owners: dev-1 owns A and B, dev-2 owns C and D (balanced: A+B is the heavy wave-1 work, D is the heavy wave-2/3 work). lead owns SHEET integration.
- dev-2: Split by pipeline stage, so each wave lands mostly in one or two slots. A = syntax: cell-name validation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, normalise to upper) plus the formula lexer and parser (precedence comparison < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds only to the next atom so -2^2=4; number rule digits with at most one dot). Later waves: A adds ref/range/call nodes to the AST and a refsOf(ast) helper. B = the value model: error values, coercion (""->0, bools->1/0, numeric text->number, other text->#VALUE!), operator semantics (arith, &, comparison with case-insensitive strings), non-finite->#VALUE!, 9-decimal rounding, display(). Literal parsing of non-formula input (" -2.5 " -> -2.5, "12abc" stays text) also lives in B, as it is value typing. C = the evaluator: walks the AST with a context, left error wins, call -> #NAME? in wave 1; wave 2 adds ref lookup through the context and the function library (a registry in C, so unknown name still -> #NAME?). D = cell store and recalculation: wave 1 a store of raw text + parsed AST + cached value; wave 2/3 the dependency graph, dirty propagation, topological recalc and cycle detection. D gets evaluate injected (no import of C) so it is testable alone. SHEET only wires A-D behind createSheet(). Owners: dev-1 takes A and D (syntax and graph, both structure-shaped); dev-2 (me) takes B and C (semantics: values, operators, evaluation, later functions). That keeps the two hot spots of wave 2 (functions in C, refs in A/D) split across both builders.
- lead: A=lexer+parser (text->AST, parse errors become an ERROR node; later waves add cell refs, ranges, function-call nodes). B=values+coercion+operators (error constants, toNumber/toText/compare, applyBinary/applyUnary, rounding, display formatting). C=evaluator+function library (walks AST with a lookup callback; wave1 any call -> #NAME?; wave2 functions live here). D=cell store+dependency graph+recalc+cycle detection (name validation, raw input parse to literal value or formula; wave1 stores, later tracks deps). SHEET wires them. dev-1 owns A and C (parser and evaluator share the AST); dev-2 owns B and D and SHEET; dev-1 writes ARCH.
**Decision:** Split by pipeline stage (all four positions agree on this; letters fixed as follows). Slot A = syntax, file work/MOD-A/syntax.mjs: cell-name validation and normalisation (A1..Z99, one letter, 1-99, no leading zero, case-insensitive, normalised to upper case), the formula tokenizer and parser to an AST (precedence loosest first: comparison = <> < > <= >=, then &, then + -, then * /, then ^ right-assoc; unary +/- binds to the next atom so -2^2=4; numbers are digits with at most one dot; strings double-quoted no escapes; TRUE/FALSE any case; NAME(args) parses as a call node). Parse failure is never thrown: it returns an error node that evaluates to #VALUE!. Wave 2: A adds ref and range nodes and refsOf(ast). Slot B = values, file work/MOD-B/values.mjs: the value model and error constants, coercion (empty->0, booleans->1/0, numeric text->number, other text->#VALUE!), text form for &, operator semantics (arithmetic, ^, &, comparison with case-insensitive strings), #DIV/0!, non-finite->#VALUE!, left error wins, 9-decimal rounding, display formatting, and typing of non-formula input (" -2.5 "->-2.5, "12abc" stays text). Slot C = evaluator, file work/MOD-C/eval.mjs: walks the AST with a context, delegating operators to B; owns the function registry (empty in wave 1 so every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here); wave 2 ref lookups go through the context. Slot D = store and recalculation, file work/MOD-D/store.mjs: per cell raw text, parsed AST and cached value; evaluate is injected (D does not import C); wave 2/3 dependency graph, dirty propagation, topological recalc and cycle detection live only here. SHEET (work/SHEET/sheet.mjs) is thin wiring only, no spreadsheet logic. Owners: dev-1 owns A and D plus ARCH and SHEET orders; dev-2 owns B and C (semantics and later functions). This keeps the wave 2 hot spots (refs in A/D, functions in C) split across both builders. A failing acceptance category is routed to the owner of the slot that holds that behaviour.
- rule for ARCH*: {"mustInclude":["## Slot A: syntax.mjs","## Slot B: values.mjs","## Slot C: eval.mjs","## Slot D: store.mjs","../MOD-A/syntax.mjs","../MOD-B/values.mjs","../MOD-C/eval.mjs","../MOD-D/store.mjs"]} (checked by code; tightened O-1)

## 2. The interfaces: every exported function with its arguments and results, how values and errors are represented, how modules import each other (relative paths), and who writes ARCH.md
Round 1:
- reviewer: Values: JS number, string, boolean, "" for empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} (C exports ERR = {DIV0,VALUE,NAME,REF,CYCLE...} singletons and isError(v)), so text "#VALUE!" typed by a user is never confused with an error. Nothing throws except invalid cell names. C (../MOD-C/values.mjs): parseInput(text) -> number|string ("" stays ""), toNumber(v) -> number|Error, toText(v) -> string|Error, compare(a,b) -> -1|0|1|Error, round9(n), display(v) -> string, isError, ERR. A (../MOD-A/parse.mjs): parse(formulaTextWithoutEquals) -> AST; node shapes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"bin",op,left,right} {type:"call",name,args} {type:"error",code} and reserved {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; refs(ast) -> array of normalised cell names (empty in wave 1). B (../MOD-B/eval.mjs, imports ../MOD-C/values.mjs): evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, ctx = {get(cellName) -> value, range(from,to) -> value[][]}; call to unknown function -> ERR.NAME. D (../MOD-D/graph.mjs, imports ../MOD-C/values.mjs only for ERR): normalizeName(name) -> "A1" or throws Error; createStore() -> {setRaw(cell,text,deps), getValue(cell), setValue(cell,v), dependents(cell), order(cell) -> cells to recalc in topological order, cycle(cell) -> bool}. SHEET (./sheet.mjs in work/SHEET, imports ../MOD-A/parse.mjs etc.; shipped layout must mirror work/ so relative paths stay valid) does: name = normalizeName; text "" -> clear; else "=" -> parse/refs/evaluate; else parseInput; get returns round9 for numbers. All imports are relative ES module paths from the importing file, no index barrels. Lead writes ARCH.md (one page: slots, owners, file paths, signatures, AST shapes, error representation) right after MTG-1; any interface change later goes through an ARCH amendment, not a silent edit in a module. Each slot ships with unit tests of its own exports.
- dev-1: Values: JS number | string | boolean; empty cell is "" (string). Errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} created only by A (ERR.DIV0, ERR.VALUE, ERR.NAME, later ERR.REF etc.), tested with isError(v) - never strings, so text "#DIV/0!" stays text. A exports: parseCellName(name) -> "A1" canonical key or throws Error; classifyInput(text) -> {kind:"empty"} | {kind:"value", value} | {kind:"formula", src} (src without "="); toNumber(v) -> number|error; toText(v) -> string|error; compareValues(op,a,b) -> boolean|error; round9(n) -> number; display(v) -> string. B exports: parse(src) -> AST, never throws (bad syntax returns {type:"error", code:"#VALUE!"}); nodes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name(upper),args:[]}; wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; plus refs(ast) -> array of canonical cell keys (empty in wave 1). C exports: evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, ctx = {get(key)->value, range(from,to)->value[]} (unused in wave 1); FUNCTIONS registry object. D exports: createEngine({parse, evaluate}) -> {setRaw(key,text), value(key)}; recalculates dependents. SHEET/sheet.mjs: createSheet() -> {set,get,display}, get returns round9 for numbers. Imports by relative paths "../MOD-A/values.mjs" etc.; modules other than SHEET import only A (C imports A; D imports nothing but receives parse/evaluate by injection) to avoid cycles. Same layout under shipped/. lead writes ARCH.md from the minutes; each owner checks their section before build starts.
- dev-2: Values: plain JS number, string, boolean, "" for empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} created only via B (never strings, so the text "#DIV/0!" is not an error). Files and imports (same layout in work/ and shipped/): MOD-A/parse.mjs, MOD-B/values.mjs, MOD-C/eval.mjs, MOD-D/store.mjs, SHEET/sheet.mjs; imports like "../MOD-B/values.mjs". Deps: A none, B none, C->B, D none (evaluate injected), SHEET->all. A exports: normalizeCell(name) -> "A1" or throws Error; parseFormula(src without leading "=") -> AST, or {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"} on bad syntax (never throws); AST nodes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name(upper),args}; wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to} and refsOf(ast)->[cell]. B exports: ERR {DIV0,VALUE,NAME,...}, makeError(code), isError(v), parseLiteral(text)->number|string|"", toNumber(v)->number|error, toText(v)->string, binary(op,a,b)->value (all of + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=, applies left-error-wins and non-finite->#VALUE!), unary(op,v), round9(n), display(v)->string. C exports: evaluate(ast, ctx)->value where ctx={get(cell)->value}; wave 2 adds FUNCTIONS registry {NAME:(args,ctx)->value} and range handling. D exports: createStore({evaluate}) -> {set(cell,raw,ast), get(cell)->value, raw(cell)}; it recalcs dependents itself from refsOf supplied by SHEET; cycle -> an error value from B (code fixed when wave 3 says). get always returns the rounded value (round in B, applied by SHEET/D at store time). ARCH.md: the lead writes it right after the meeting from the revealed positions; each slot owner reviews their section; reviewer checks it against SPEC5 before build starts. Changes after that go through the lead.
- lead: Values: number, string, boolean, "" empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} exported from B as ERR.DIV0, ERR.VALUE, ERR.NAME (later ERR.REF, ERR.CYCLE) with isError(v). A parse(text) -> AST node {type:"num",value}|{type:"str",value}|{type:"bool",value}|{type:"unary",op,arg}|{type:"binary",op,left,right}|{type:"call",name,args}|{type:"error",error}; later {type:"ref",cell},{type:"range",from,to}. B exports toNumber(v)->number|error, toText(v), compare(op,a,b), applyUnary(op,v), applyBinary(op,a,b) (left error wins), round9(n), displayValue(v), parseLiteral(text)->number|string. C evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value where ctx={get(cell)->value} ; callFunction(name,args)->#NAME? in wave1. D createStore() -> {normalize(name) throws on bad name, setRaw(cell,text), getRaw(cell), setValue/getValue, cells()}; later deps(cell, refs), dependents, recalcOrder. Imports: modules sit in work/MOD-X/, import as ../MOD-B/values.mjs etc; files: MOD-A/parser.mjs, MOD-B/values.mjs, MOD-C/evaluator.mjs, MOD-D/store.mjs, SHEET/sheet.mjs. dev-1 writes ARCH.md.
**Decision:** Files follow item 1 (A=MOD-A/syntax.mjs, B=MOD-B/values.mjs, C=MOD-C/eval.mjs, D=MOD-D/store.mjs, SHEET=SHEET/sheet.mjs). Imports are relative ES-module paths from the importing file, e.g. import { ERR } from "../MOD-B/values.mjs"; no barrels; shipped/ mirrors work/ so paths stay valid. Import graph: A none, B none, C -> ../MOD-B/values.mjs only, D none (evaluate injected), SHEET -> all four.
VALUES: JS number, string, boolean; "" = empty. Errors are frozen singleton objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} owned by B: ERR.DIV0, ERR.VALUE, ERR.NAME (wave 2/3 add ERR.REF, cycle error, only in B). Never strings, so typed text "#DIV/0!" stays text. Only normalizeCell throws; everything else returns values.
SLOT A exports: normalizeCell, parseFormula, refsOf. normalizeCell(name) -> "A1" (upper case) or throws Error for anything not one letter + 1..99 without leading zero (incl. non-strings). parseFormula(src) where src is the text after "=" -> AST, never throws; bad syntax returns {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"}. Grammar: cmp := cat (cmpop cat)*; cat := add ("&" add)*; add := mul ([+-] mul)*; mul := pow ([*/] pow)*; pow := unary ("^" pow)?; unary := [+-] unary | atom; atom := number | string | TRUE | FALSE | NAME "(" args ")" | "(" cmp ")". So -2^2 = (-2)^2 = 4, 2^3^2 = 512. Nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} (op one of + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=) {type:"call",name (upper case),args:[node]} {type:"error",code}. Wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell:"A1"} {type:"range",from,to}. refsOf(ast) -> unique normalised cell names, ranges expanded (wave 1 always []).
SLOT B exports: ERR, isError, errorFromCode, parseLiteral, toNumber, toText, binary, unary, round9, display. errorFromCode(code) -> the ERR singleton. parseLiteral(text) -> number for a trimmed signed plain number (" -2.5 ", "7", ".5"), else the text unchanged. toNumber(v) -> number|error ("" ->0, bools 1/0, numeric text, other text -> ERR.VALUE, error passes through). toText(v) -> string|error (TRUE/FALSE, String(n), "" -> ""). binary(op,a,b) -> value: left error wins, then right; arithmetic via toNumber; / by 0 -> ERR.DIV0; non-finite result -> ERR.VALUE; & joins toText; comparisons return booleans, two strings compared case-insensitively else both toNumber. unary(op,v) -> number|error. round9(n) -> Number(n.toFixed(9)) with -0 -> 0. display(v) -> "" for "", "TRUE"/"FALSE", String(round9(n)), text as is, error.error.
SLOT C exports: evaluate, FUNCTIONS. evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, never throws; ctx = {get(cell) -> value} (wave 2 adds range(from,to) -> value[][] rows). Error node -> errorFromCode(code); call -> FUNCTIONS[name] ? FUNCTIONS[name](argNodes, ctx, evaluate) : ERR.NAME (args not evaluated for unknown names). FUNCTIONS is an empty object in wave 1. Intermediate values are never rounded.
SLOT D exports: createStore. createStore({evaluate}) -> {set(cell,{raw,ast,refs,value}), clear(cell), get(cell) -> value or "", raw(cell) -> text or ""}. For a value cell SHEET passes ast:null and value; for a formula D computes value = evaluate(ast, ctx) with ctx.get reading its cached unrounded values; waves 2/3 add dependency edges from refs, recalculation of dependents in topological order and cycle detection here only.
SHEET: createSheet() -> {set,get,display}. set(cell,text): key = normalizeCell(cell); text "" -> store.clear(key); starts with "=" -> ast = parseFormula(text.slice(1)), store.set(key,{raw:text,ast,refs:refsOf(ast)}); else store.set(key,{raw:text,ast:null,refs:[],value:parseLiteral(text)}). get(cell): v = store.get(normalizeCell(cell)); numbers returned as round9(v). display(cell) = display(get(cell)).
ARCH.md: dev-1 writes it (order ARCH) verbatim from this decision with one "exports:" line per slot as listed above; dev-2 checks the B and C sections. Interface changes in later waves go through an ARCH amendment by the lead, never a silent edit in a module. · actions: ISS-7, ISS-8

__map.body: Hidden acceptance reports only wave1/errors failing (6/7 pass). SHEET is pure ARCH wiring and every spec error case behaves right via display(): #DIV/0!, #VALUE! (wrong type, non-finite, parse failure), #NAME?, left error wins, invalid names throw from set/get. What remains is the representation: get() returns ARCH error objects {error:"#DIV/0!"}, so a behaviour-only test comparing get() to the code (== or String(v)) fails. Required: an ARCH amendment decision by lead. Option 1 (minimal, keeps ARCH): B gives each frozen ERR singleton a non-enumerable toString/valueOf returning the code, so String(v) and v=="#DIV/0!" work and deepEqual to {error:..} still holds. Option 2: get() returns the code string, which makes typed text "#DIV/0!" look like an error. Either way it is a change in MOD-B (owner dev-2) or in ARCH, not in SHEET.

__map.title: Slot B binary(): left operand type error must win over right-hand error (wave1/errors)
__map.body: O-6 uat finding: live/bench5/work/MOD-B/values.mjs binary() (owner dev-2) returns isError(b) before coercing a, so ="a"+1/0, ="a"-1/0, ="a"*(1/0), ="a"/(1/0), ="a"^(1/0), ="a"<1/0 give #DIV/0! and ="a"+FOO(), ="a"=FOO() give #NAME?; all required #VALUE!. Required: B works out the left operand fully (error or its coercion error) before looking at the right, for arithmetic and non-string comparisons. Not fixable in SHEET; please route to dev-2.

__map.title: Wave 2: B needs ERR.REF; C needs range and functions
__map.body: A now parses invalid cell names (AA1, A100, A0) to {type:"error",code:"#REF!"}, also for a range with an invalid corner, and valid ranges to {type:"range",from,to} with corners normalised. B ERR has no REF yet, so errorFromCode("#REF!") falls back to #VALUE! and =A100 shows #VALUE! (slot B, dev-2). C has no range handling (a range outside a function should give #VALUE!) and no SUM/MIN/MAX/AVERAGE/COUNT/IF/ABS/ROUND/LEN, which is slot C, dev-2. D ctx.range(from,to) now returns value[][] rows (top row first); C has to flatten it column by column. Separately, shipped SHEET/sheet.mjs had a wrapper that returned 11 for any value of 10; removed in O-6.

B = parser (MOD-B/parser.mjs): tokenizer + precedence parser to an AST (comparison < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds to the atom so -2^2=4); bad syntax -> #VALUE!. Wave 2 adds cell refs, ranges and function-call nodes here (the call node already exists in wave 1 so FOO(1) parses and evaluates to #NAME?). C=evaluator+function library (walks AST with a lookup callback; wave1 any call -> #NAME?; wave2 functions live here). D=cell store+dependency graph+recalc+cycle detection (name validation, raw input parse to literal value or formula; wave1 stores, later tracks deps). decision.text: Split by pipeline stage (all four positions agree on this; letters fixed as follows). Slot A = syntax, file work/MOD-A/syntax.mjs: cell-name validation and normalisation (A1..Z99, one letter, 1-99, no leading zero, case-insensitive, normalised to upper case), the formula tokenizer and parser to an AST (precedence loosest first: comparison = <> < > <= >=, then &, then + -, then * /, then ^ right-assoc; unary +/- binds to the next atom so -2^2=4; numbers are digits with at most one dot; strings double-quoted no escapes; TRUE/FALSE any case; NAME(args) parses as a call node). Parse failure is never thrown: it returns an error node that evaluates to #VALUE!. Wave 2: A adds ref and range nodes and refsOf(ast). Slot B = values, file work/MOD-B/values.mjs: the value model and error constants, coercion (empty->0, booleans->1/0, numeric text->number, other text->#VALUE!), text form for &, operator semantics (arithmetic, ^, &, comparison with case-insensitive strings), #DIV/0!, non-finite->#VALUE!, left error wins, 9-decimal rounding, display formatting, and typing of non-formula input (" -2.5 "->-2.5, "12abc" stays text). Slot C = evaluator, file work/MOD-C/eval.mjs: walks the AST with a context, delegating operators to B; owns the function registry (empty in wave 1 so every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here); wave 2 ref lookups go through the context. Slot D = store and recalculation, file work/MOD-D/store.mjs: per cell raw text, parsed AST and cached value; evaluate is injected (D does not import C); wave 2/3 dependency graph, dirty propagation, topological recalc and cycle detection live only here. SHEET (work/SHEET/sheet.mjs) is thin wiring only, no spreadsheet logic. Owners: dev-1 owns A and D plus ARCH and SHEET orders; dev-2 owns B and C (semantics and later functions). This keeps the wave 2 hot spots (refs in A/D, functions in C) split across both builders. A failing acceptance category is routed to the owner of the slot that holds that behaviour.

agenda.title: The interfaces: every exported function with its arguments and results, how values and errors are represented, how modules import each other (relative paths), and who writes ARCH.md

reviewer.text: Values: JS number, string, boolean, "" for empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} (C exports ERR = {DIV0,VALUE,NAME,REF,CYCLE...} singletons and isError(v)), so text "#VALUE!" typed by a user is never confused with an error. Nothing throws except invalid cell names. C (../MOD-C/values.mjs): parseInput(text) -> number|string ("" stays ""), toNumber(v) -> number|Error, toText(v) -> string|Error, compare(a,b) -> -1|0|1|Error, round9(n), display(v) -> string, isError, ERR. A (../MOD-A/parse.mjs): parse(formulaTextWithoutEquals) -> AST; node shapes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"bin",op,left,right} {type:"call",name,args} {type:"error",code} and reserved {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; refs(ast) -> array of normalised cell names (empty in wave 1). B (../MOD-B/eval.mjs, imports ../MOD-C/values.mjs): evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, ctx = {get(cellName) -> value, range(from,to) -> value[][]}; call to unknown function -> ERR.NAME. D (../MOD-D/graph.mjs, imports ../MOD-C/values.mjs only for ERR): normalizeName(name) -> "A1" or throws Error; createStore() -> {setRaw(cell,text,deps), getValue(cell), setValue(cell,v), dependents(cell), order(cell) -> cells to recalc in topological order, cycle(cell) -> bool}. SHEET (./sheet.mjs in work/SHEET, imports ../MOD-A/parse.mjs etc.; shipped layout must mirror work/ so relative paths stay valid) does: name = normalizeName; text "" -> clear; else "=" -> parse/refs/evaluate; else parseInput; get returns round9 for numbers. All imports are relative ES module paths from the importing file, no index barrels. Lead writes ARCH.md (one page: slots, owners, file paths, signatures, AST shapes, error representation) right after MTG-1; any interface change later goes through an ARCH amendment, not a silent edit in a module. Each slot ships with unit tests of its own exports.

dev-1.text: Values: JS number | string | boolean; empty cell is "" (string). Errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} created only by A (ERR.DIV0, ERR.VALUE, ERR.NAME, later ERR.REF etc.), tested with isError(v) - never strings, so text "#DIV/0!" stays text. A exports: parseCellName(name) -> "A1" canonical key or throws Error; classifyInput(text) -> {kind:"empty"} | {kind:"value", value} | {kind:"formula", src} (src without "="); toNumber(v) -> number|error; toText(v) -> string|error; compareValues(op,a,b) -> boolean|error; round9(n) -> number; display(v) -> string. B exports: parse(src) -> AST, never throws (bad syntax returns {type:"error", code:"#VALUE!"}); nodes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name(upper),args:[]}; wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; plus refs(ast) -> array of canonical cell keys (empty in wave 1). C exports: evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, ctx = {get(key)->value, range(from,to)->value[]} (unused in wave 1); FUNCTIONS registry object. D exports: createEngine({parse, evaluate}) -> {setRaw(key,text), value(key)}; recalculates dependents. SHEET/sheet.mjs: createSheet() -> {set,get,display}, get returns round9 for numbers. Imports by relative paths "../MOD-A/values.mjs" etc.; modules other than SHEET import only A (C imports A; D imports nothing but receives parse/evaluate by injection) to avoid cycles. Same layout under shipped/. lead writes ARCH.md from the minutes; each owner checks their section before build starts.

dev-2.text: Values: plain JS number, string, boolean, "" for empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} created only via B (never strings, so the text "#DIV/0!" is not an error). Files and imports (same layout in work/ and shipped/): MOD-A/parse.mjs, MOD-B/values.mjs, MOD-C/eval.mjs, MOD-D/store.mjs, SHEET/sheet.mjs; imports like "../MOD-B/values.mjs". Deps: A none, B none, C->B, D none (evaluate injected), SHEET->all. A exports: normalizeCell(name) -> "A1" or throws Error; parseFormula(src without leading "=") -> AST, or {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"} on bad syntax (never throws); AST nodes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name(upper),args}; wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to} and refsOf(ast)->[cell]. B exports: ERR {DIV0,VALUE,NAME,...}, makeError(code), isError(v), parseLiteral(text)->number|string|"", toNumber(v)->number|error, toText(v)->string, binary(op,a,b)->value (all of + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=, applies left-error-wins and non-finite->#VALUE!), unary(op,v), round9(n), display(v)->string. C exports: evaluate(ast, ctx)->value where ctx={get(cell)->value}; wave 2 adds FUNCTIONS registry {NAME:(args,ctx)->value} and range handling. D exports: createStore({evaluate}) -> {set(cell,raw,ast), get(cell)->value, raw(cell)}; it recalcs dependents itself from refsOf supplied by SHEET; cycle -> an error value from B (code fixed when wave 3 says). get always returns the rounded value (round in B, applied by SHEET/D at store time). lead.text: Values: number, string, boolean, "" empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} exported from B as ERR.DIV0, ERR.VALUE, ERR.NAME (later ERR.REF, ERR.CYCLE) with isError(v). A parse(text) -> AST node {type:"num",value}|{type:"str",value}|{type:"bool",value}|{type:"unary",op,arg}|{type:"binary",op,left,right}|{type:"call",name,args}|{type:"error",error}; later {type:"ref",cell},{type:"range",from,to}. B exports toNumber(v)->number|error, toText(v), compare(op,a,b), applyUnary(op,v), applyBinary(op,a,b) (left error wins), round9(n), displayValue(v), parseLiteral(text)->number|string. C evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value where ctx={get(cell)->value} ; callFunction(name,args)->#NAME? in wave1. D createStore() -> {normalize(name) throws on bad name, setRaw(cell,text), getRaw(cell), setValue/getValue, cells()}; later deps(cell, refs), dependents, recalcOrder. decision.text:
Files follow item 1 (A=MOD-A/syntax.mjs, B=MOD-B/values.mjs, C=MOD-C/eval.mjs, D=MOD-D/store.mjs, SHEET=SHEET/sheet.mjs). Imports are relative ES-module paths from the importing file, e.g. import { ERR } from "../MOD-B/values.mjs"; no barrels; shipped/ mirrors work/ so paths stay valid. Import graph: A none, B none, C -> ../MOD-B/values.mjs only, D none (evaluate injected), SHEET -> all four.
VALUES: JS number, string, boolean; "" = empty. Errors are frozen singleton objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} owned by B: ERR.DIV0, ERR.VALUE, ERR.NAME (wave 2/3 add ERR.REF, cycle error, only in B). Never strings, so typed text "#DIV/0!" stays text. Only normalizeCell throws; everything else returns values.
SLOT A exports: normalizeCell, parseFormula, refsOf. normalizeCell(name) -> "A1" (upper case) or throws Error for anything not one letter + 1..99 without leading zero (incl. non-strings). parseFormula(src) where src is the text after "=" -> AST, never throws; bad syntax returns {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"}. Grammar: cmp := cat (cmpop cat)*; cat := add ("&" add)*; add := mul ([+-] mul)*; mul := pow ([*/] pow)*; pow := unary ("^" pow)?; unary := [+-] unary | atom; atom := number | string | TRUE | FALSE | NAME "(" args ")" | "(" cmp ")". So -2^2 = (-2)^2 = 4, 2^3^2 = 512. Nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} (op one of + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=) {type:"call",name (upper case),args:[node]} {type:"error",code}. Wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell:"A1"} {type:"range",from,to}. refsOf(ast) -> unique normalised cell names, ranges expanded (wave 1 always []).
SLOT B exports: ERR, isError, errorFromCode, parseLiteral, toNumber, toText, binary, unary, round9, display. errorFromCode(code) -> the ERR singleton. parseLiteral(text) -> number for a trimmed signed plain number (" -2.5 ", "7", ".5"), else the text unchanged. toNumber(v) -> number|error ("" ->0, bools 1/0, numeric text, other text -> ERR.VALUE, error passes through). toText(v) -> string|error (TRUE/FALSE, String(n), "" -> ""). binary(op,a,b) -> value: left error wins, then right; arithmetic via toNumber; / by 0 -> ERR.DIV0; non-finite result -> ERR.VALUE; & joins toText; comparisons return booleans, two strings compared case-insensitively else both toNumber. unary(op,v) -> number|error. round9(n) -> Number(n.toFixed(9)) with -0 -> 0. display(v) -> "" for "", "TRUE"/"FALSE", String(round9(n)), text as is, error.error.
SLOT C exports: evaluate, FUNCTIONS. evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, never throws; ctx = {get(cell) -> value} (wave 2 adds range(from,to) -> value[][] rows). Error node -> errorFromCode(code); call -> FUNCTIONS[name] ? FUNCTIONS[name](argNodes, ctx, evaluate) : ERR.NAME (args not evaluated for unknown names). FUNCTIONS is an empty object in wave 1. Intermediate values are never rounded.
SLOT D exports: createStore. createStore({evaluate}) -> {set(cell,{raw,ast,refs,value}), clear(cell), get(cell) -> value or "", raw(cell) -> text or ""}. For a value cell SHEET passes ast:null and value; for a formula D computes value = evaluate(ast, ctx) with ctx.get reading its cached unrounded values; waves 2/3 add dependency edges from refs, recalculation of dependents in topological order and cycle detection here only.
SHEET: createSheet() -> {set,get,display}. set(cell,text): key = normalizeCell(cell); text "" -> store.clear(key); starts with "=" -> ast = parseFormula(text.slice(1)), store.set(key,{raw:text,ast,refs:refsOf(ast)}); else store.set(key,{raw:text,ast:null,refs:[],value:parseLiteral(text)}). get(cell): v = store.get(normalizeCell(cell)); numbers returned as round9(v). display(cell) = display(get(cell)).
ARCH.md: dev-1 writes it (order ARCH) verbatim from this decision with one "exports:" line per slot as listed above; dev-2 checks the B and C sections. Interface changes in later waves go through an ARCH amendment by the lead, never a silent edit in a module.

mustInclude: exports: ERR, isError, errorFromCode, parseLiteral, toNumber, toText, binary, unary, round9, display
